narrative.overview: The user-pinned fighting-game selection reference becomes an emerald, forest-black campus arena. Large fighter portraits, condensed italic names, angular frames and command meters carry the experience, rather than a dashboard skin.
keyCharacteristics: Forest-dark surfaces, bright emerald selection, white combat information.
Strong type hierarchy and square/angular controls.
Original replaceable fighter art; real numeric command profiles.

rules.name: The Selection Rule
rules.body: Emerald outlines and bounded light identify the active fighter, never an implied gameplay advantage beyond the displayed stats.

dos: Do carry the forest/emerald/white world across setup, combat and results.
Do keep labels, units and exact values alongside segmented bars.
Do preserve original artwork IDs so final art can replace placeholders without changing game rules.
Do prioritize readable controls and authoritative connection states over effects.
donts: Don't turn the roster into a generic rounded dashboard grid.
Don't copy the reference's third-party characters or red palette.
Don't let decorative ratings differ from the authoritative combat values.
